'''Ploo IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ploo sector/Legends|Ploo sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==Description==
[[File:ElanMak-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Kam Nale]], a [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] from Ploo IV.]]
The planet's surface consisted mostly of vast [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], [[Swamp/Legends|marshlands]], and floating cities that were connected by vast tubes that were situated beneath the surface of the [[Water/Legends|water]].

==History==
The natives of Ploo IV, the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrians]], were constantly at war with the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphids]], inhabitants of the nearby planet of [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]].

The [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]] [[Kam Nale]] was from Ploo IV. He raced in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].
